selected.note: H8: product encoding out-of-fold over 3 coarse chronological blocks instead of 10 (windows unchanged). Hypothesis: finer blocks let near-in-time sibling recalls inflate training encodings relative to prediction time, where only distant labels exist. Local: block count 100/30/10/4/3 gives monotone small gains for coarser blocks; 3 blocks is >= H5 on all four training-only splits and validation (+0.0009 mean, noise-level)
